rules.text:
HOW TO PLAY
ARIZONA TREASURE HUNT
Step 1,
Purchase a Ticket

Find an Arizona Lottery retailer and tell the cashier you’d like to purchase a Arizona Treasure Hunt ticket. Tickets cannot be purchased online.

Step 2,
How to Play

STEP 1
Scratch the TREASURE MAP COORDINATES to reveal 24 TREASURE MAP locations.


STEP 2
For each of the TREASURE MAP COORDINATES revealed, find the corresponding location on the TREASURE MAP and scratch that square.


STEP 3
If, using the TREASURE MAP COORDINATES, you uncover all the required squares to reveal the entire symbol as shown in the PRIZE LEGEND, you win the corresponding prize for that symbol.

Step 3,
Claim Your Winnings

All Arizona Lottery retailers will redeem prizes up to $100, and may redeem prizes up to $599. See full details about How to Claim Prizes.
